options.content:
# Hermes Tool Usage

This dashboard is for the proposed shared collector scraped as **`hermes_tools`**. It displays bounded aggregate labels only: **profile**, **tool name**, **outcome**, **direction**, and **tokenizer**. Tool arguments, results, prompts, identifiers, filesystem paths, error text, and credentials must never be exported.

> **Estimated serialized payload tokens** approximate the size of tool request and response payloads (for example, `bytes_div_4`). They are **not** model-provider billing tokens and **not** downstream LLM token consumption.

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome
panels.description: Per-second completed tool-call rate over five minutes, grouped by bounded tool name and outcome. Counter resets from collector restarts are handled by rate().

panels.title: Tool-call duration (p50 / p95)
panels.description: 50th- and 95th-percentile duration over five minutes, calculated from the Prometheus histogram buckets. Percentiles are unavailable until histogram observations have been recorded.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, tool_name) (rate(hermes_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool_name) (rate(hermes_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"}[5m])))

panels.title: Serialized payload throughput
panels.description: Serialized request and response payload bytes per second over five minutes. This is aggregate size telemetry only; payload content is never exported.

panels.title: Estimated serialized payload-token throughput
panels.description: Estimated serialized request and response payload tokens per second over five minutes. This is a size estimate by tokenizer, not model-provider billing or downstream LLM token consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (rate(hermes_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="hermes_tools", profile=~"$profile", tool_name=~"$tool"}[5m]))
